name: git-free-runtime-state
goal: Verify declared Hub runtime outputs without depending on a Git checkout

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A clean verification export has no Git metadata. Runtime-output guards must use disposable fixture commits.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: 697023c clean verification: test/self-verify-runtime-state.test.ts failed at git ls-files with not-a-git-repository; three controls passed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Replace current-checkout index inspection with fixture snapshot misdeclared-output and tracked-file mutation assertions. Preserve exact declared-state output checks.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: All four runtime-output guards pass both in the checkout and a Git-free export with the repaired test. Tracked state mutation still fails.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
